text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France urges Turkish troops to withdraw from northern Iraq.
- Italian MPs start talks with Iraqi National Assembly.
- World organisations continue condemnation of Turkish incursion in northern Iraq.
- Deputy Prime Minister Aziz meets president of Russian republic.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Ship loaded with sugar docks at Umm Qasr port in southern Iraq.
